Procurement and administration · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Indirect purchase requisition triage

Samuel · Procurement Coordinator

The purchasing department of a private university with 4 campuses receives about 520 requisitions a month from academic coordinators, labs and administrative areas.

When it runs
Twice a day, at 9 a.m. and 3 p.m., on the requisitions created in the purchasing portal since the last reading
What it delivers in production
Twice a day, the queue of new requisitions classified as fill under contract, quote, return or document required, with the procurement method indicated by the policy and the urgency derived from the need date and the academic calendar.
Who decides
Classifies and drafts; the buyer sends
Effort
Calibrate on 100 requisitions; 2 weeks of checks
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files

Do this

  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test

# Indirect purchasing policy

Example for a university. Replace it with your institution's policy.

## Modalities
| Amount (requisition + bought_year of the item) | Modality | Typical lead time |
|---|---|---|
| up to R$ 5,000.00 | direct purchase, 1 quote | 7 business days |
| from R$ 5,000.01 to R$ 50,000.00 | 3 quotes | 15 business days |
| above R$ 50,000.00 | formal price bid | 30 business days |
Item covered by a contract in force: direct order to the contract supplier, 5 business days.

## Documents by category
| Category | Required document |
|---|---|
| Controlled reagent | technical officer's report |
| Biological material | biosafety report |
| Air conditioning | technical specification |
| Software | approval from the IT coordination |
Other categories: no document besides the requisition.

## Reading
- Contract in force: expiry equal to or later than today. Specification equal to the catalog's; "compatible" is not "original".
- Item outside the catalog or too generic to find in the catalog: product not identifiable.
- Business days exclude Saturday, Sunday and holidays (Nov 20 and Dec 25).

## Rules with no leeway
- A repeated number counts once. E.g.: REQ-41202 appears 2 times: 12 requisitions, not 13.
- Modality by the amount added to bought_year. E.g.: REQ-41210, toner, R$ 2,100.00 + R$ 3,400.00 = R$ 5,500.00: 3 quotes, arrival on Dec 8, after Nov 27: HIGH and PRIORITY. The toner contract is for compatible toner: it does not apply.
- An expired contract does not cover the item. E.g.: REQ-41211, water, contract until Oct 31, 2026: QUOTE, direct purchase (R$ 1,040.00 + R$ 3,200.00), arrival Nov 26 after Nov 23: HIGH and PRIORITY.
- A controlled reagent without a report never becomes QUOTE. E.g.: REQ-41201, needed on Nov 30, 14 days away: DOCUMENT REQUIRED and PURCHASING COORDINATION.
- Escalation by the amount of the requisition itself; every band reached applies. E.g.: REQ-41209, R$ 52,800.00: formal price bid and PURCHASING COORDINATION.
- The return draft lists only what is missing. E.g.: REQ-41208 and REQ-41212 (Languages): the cost center is missing.
- A research project overrides a document. E.g.: REQ-41207 (PROJ-FAPX-0912, DNA extraction kit, biological material, R$ 6,200.00): AGENCY RULE, not DOCUMENT REQUIRED. SUMMARY: 1 by contract, 6 quote, 3 return, 1 document required (41201), 1 agency rule (41207).
- The final answer, the run report and the STATE are outputs too: what a rule says to omit does not appear in them, not even to explain the exclusion.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI does not return requisitions or write to the requester: it drafts and the buyer sends, because a return restarts the clock and a wrong return delays a class. A controlled reagent, radioactive material or biological organism with no technical officer's report never comes out as ready to quote, whatever the urgency. It does not choose suppliers or estimate market prices. A requisition funded by a research funding agency follows the agency's rules, and it flags that when the cost center belongs to a project.

Common mistakes

  • Setting the procurement method by the single amount when the policy adds up requisitions for the same item over the year; splitting changes the method.
  • Treating a similar item with a different specification as covered by the contract, 75g paper against 90g.
  • Prioritizing by order of arrival and ignoring the need date of the lab class.
  • Taking as complete a requisition with every field filled in and a generic description, such as 'software for the lab'.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Days between requisition creation and first return to the requesterfrom 4 days to under 1 dayestimate based on the described routine
Requisitions quoted for an item already covered by a current contractfrom about 1 in 8 to fewer than 1 in 50estimate based on the described routine
Accuracy in identifying contract items in calibration90% or more, verified in calibrationestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Triage of the 14 requisitions created between 2026-08-31 15:00 and 2026-09-01 9:00.

REQ-30412 | Chemistry Lab, North campus | 40 bottles of hydrochloric acid 37% | R$ 2,800 | need date 2026-09-15 | classification: DOCUMENT REQUIRED, controlled reagent with no technical officer's report attached | method: direct purchase (below R$ 5 thousand) | urgency HIGH, 2nd semester lab class on 2026-09-14
REQ-30413 | Education Program Coordination | 12 reams of A4 paper | R$ 380 | classification: FILL UNDER CONTRACT, item 'A4 paper 75g' covered by contract CT-2025-08 until 2027-03 | action: order from the contract supplier, no quote
REQ-30414 | IT, South campus | 'software license for the lab' | R$ 18,000 | classification: RETURN, no product name, number of licenses or IT coordination approval | return draft ready for review
REQ-30415 | Maintenance | 3 air conditioners 18,000 BTU | R$ 9,600 | classification: QUOTE, 3 quotes required (between R$ 5 thousand and R$ 50 thousand) | complete specification | urgency MEDIUM
REQ-30416 | Library | 200 copies of a textbook | R$ 34,000 | classification: QUOTE, check whether the publisher is an exclusive supplier before waiving quotes | urgency HIGH, semester starts on 2026-09-14

SUMMARY: 14 requisitions; 4 under contract, 5 quote, 3 return, 2 require documents. Most frequent return: missing cost center (Languages Program Coordination, 2 of 3).
